kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of the verb نَوَى (nawā).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَنْوِيّ • (manwiyy) (feminine مَنْوِيَّة (manwiyya), masculine plural مَنْوِيُّون (manwiyyūn), feminine plural مَنْوِيَّات (manwiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the passive participle of نَوَى (nawā).
Compare Classical Syriac ܢܹܐ (nē, “please”) and Hebrew נָא (ná, “please (adverb), if you please”).
g: verbal noun of نَوَى (nawā, “to think, to intend”) (form I)
will, tendency, inclination, wish, object of investigation

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Verbal noun of نَوَى (nawā, “to intend, to determine (to do something)”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic نَوَاة (nawāh)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)

From نَوَاة (nawāh, “nucleus”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
